stories.title: The Brave Little Bunny
pages: Once upon a time, in a small forest, there lived a brave little bunny who loved making new friends.
One sunny morning, the bunny met a tiny butterfly fluttering by the river.
Together they hopped and flew across the meadow, discovering red, yellow and purple flowers.
When the sun went down, the bunny hugged the butterfly goodnight. They promised to play again tomorrow. The end.

stories.title: The Sleepy Moon
pages: High up in the sky, the moon gave a big, slow yawn.
The stars twinkled one by one to say goodnight to the owls, the cats and the little fish.
Down below, every child snuggled into bed, warm and cozy.
And the sleepy moon smiled and whispered, sweet dreams. The end.
